s: Hugo Ortega's Pacific-coast Mexican, with Asian riffs, in downtown Houston
w: Chef Hugo Ortega's downtown room built around Las Californias-style Mexican cooking -- whole grilled fish, aguachile, seafood towers -- filtered through Pacific-coast Asian influence. One of Robb Report's 10 Best New Restaurants for 2026 and part of the wave putting Houston's fine-dining scene on the national map.

s: a 24-seat, one-Michelin-star coastal tasting counter in Carlsbad
w: Chef Eric Bost's Michelin-starred tasting counter draws its menu straight from the Southern California coastline -- spot prawns with sea buckthorn, lime leaf, serrano and gooseberry among the dishes -- served to 24 guests around the counter. A serious, destination-level kitchen in an unassuming beach town north of San Diego.
